    • putProjectInBin

      public void putProjectInBin(Long projectId)
      PUT api/projects/{projectId: [0-9]+}/PutInBin calls ProjectRestEndpoint.putProjectInBin(java.lang.Long) Put the given project in the bin. (= set DeletionStatus to BIN + set erasure tracking data)
      Parameters:

      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist

    • restoreProjectFromBin

      public void restoreProjectFromBin(Long projectId)
      PUT api/projects/{projectId: [0-9]+}/RestoreFromBin calls ProjectRestEndpoint.restoreProjectFromBin(java.lang.Long) Restore from the bin. The project won't contain any deletion or erasure data anymore.

      It means that the project is back at its place.

      Parameters:
      projectId - the id of the project
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist

    • flagProjectAsToDeleteForever

      public void flagProjectAsToDeleteForever(Long projectId)
      PUT api/projects/{projectId: [0-9]+}/FlagAsToDeleteForever calls ProjectRestEndpoint.flagProjectAsToDeleteForever(java.lang.Long) Set the deletion status to TO_DELETE.

      It means that the project is only visible in the bin panel.

      Parameters:
      projectId - the id of the project
      Throws:
      ch.colabproject.colab.generator.model.exceptions.HttpErrorMessage - if project does not exist
